title: Drop Oracle Machine Transition Function
statement: For each Boolean parameter $b$, define a transition function for a machine with nine registers, two oracle languages, and the finite control states listed in the declaration. At each control state, the function prescribes the corresponding register operation, branch, oracle call, or halt exactly as specified by the transition rules; when the search reaches a match, it returns true if $b$ is true and otherwise queries the first oracle before choosing its answer.
caveat: The supplied declaration gives a large transition table in terms of auxiliary states and encodings but does not provide their informal meanings or the machine semantics, so a self-contained mathematical description of the transitions cannot be reconstructed faithfully.
